## [0.9.5] - 2026-11-23

### 修复
- 启用音量上限时点击静音，浮层显示的音量就是端点实际生效的值；下一次滚轮从该值接着走，不再从端点从未有过的位置起步。
- 切换默认设备失败时，对话框显示端点自己报告的错误，不再被后续候选的“类未注册”覆盖。
- 音量通知注册失败时记录原因并继续重试；外部音量变化不再无声失效。

### Fixed
- With the volume limit enabled, muting reports the level the endpoint actually applied, and the next wheel step continues from that level instead of one the endpoint never had.
- A failed default-device switch names the error the endpoint reported instead of a later candidate's "class not registered".
- A failed volume-notification registration is logged with its cause and retried; external volume changes no longer go dark silently.
